messages.「赤眼」と「懺悔」でスキルを強化しながら戦い、通常のS3「ドタマを割る」で一気に: Fight with skills enhanced by Red Eyes and Penitence, use regular S3 Skullbuster to build both quickly, then unleash Serious Skullbuster when its conditions are met for heavy damage and ally healing. A self-sufficient Identity that performs consistently across teams.
messages.通常のS3「ドタマを割る」: Ⅰコイン的中時に赤眼7と懺悔7を得る。Ⅱコイン表面: **Regular S3 — Skullbuster**: Gains 7 Red Eyes and 7 Penitence on Coin Ⅰ hit. Coin Ⅱ grants 2 Penitence on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅲ heals HP and SP for herself and allies (SP by the amount of Penitence above 10). At max SP, she gains +2 Clash Power and +1 Coin Power, and loses 15 SP after the attack.
messages.赤眼・懺悔による強化: S1「どっちも黙れ」は赤眼7以上でコイン威力+1、懺悔7: **Bonuses from Red Eyes and Penitence**: S1 Both of You, Shut Up gains +1 Coin Power with at least 7 Red Eyes and +1/2 Clash Power with at least 7 Penitence. S2 S.H. / S.F. gains +1 Coin Power when Red Eyes and Penitence total at least 20/15, and +1 more if the target has at least 6 Bleed.
messages.赤眼・懺悔の獲得: S1・S2・守備のコイン的中時に得る。充電回数を得る効果も代: **Gaining Red Eyes and Penitence**: Gained on Coin hits of S1, S2, and her Defense skill. Effects that would grant Charge Count grant these instead (E.G.O Assimilation). Through the combat passive Spiderhead/Skullface (3 Lust and 3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), Coins that grant Red Eyes or Penitence deal more damage based on each value, and she also gains Penitence when taking damage, up to 3.
messages.「ガチでドタマを割る」: 赤眼と懺悔がそれぞれ15以上のとき、S3がこれに変わる: **Serious Skullbuster**: S3 turns into this when Red Eyes and Penitence are each at 15 or more. It spends all of both, gaining +1 Coin Power per 5 Red Eyes and +1 Base Power per 5 Penitence, up to 4 each, and Coin Ⅲ gains +2.5/4% damage per point spent, up to 100/160%. It heals allies' HP and SP and inflicts 3 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down. She loses 15 SP after the attack.
messages.通常S3は序盤に使っても強い。Ⅰコインで赤眼7・懺悔7を得るので、これだけでS1: The regular S3 is strong even early on. Coin Ⅰ grants 7 Red Eyes and 7 Penitence, which alone meets S1's bonus conditions (7 or more each). S2's condition (20/15 total) cannot be reached with 14, and a single S3 meets it only at higher Uptie when Coin Ⅱ's Heads Hit adds 2 Penitence (16 total). Red Eyes and Penitence are gained on Coin hits, so choose opponents who will not break her Coins in Clashes. Once both reach 15, release them with the enhanced version. Spending everything means building up again, so it works well to aim for it with the second S3 cycle or save it for the finishing blow.
